text_block_list.text:
In the early morning of Funabashi, the 
sound of countless hoofbeats echoed across 
the track.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Funabashi! Fight-oh! Fight-oh! Fight-oh!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

It was a familiar sight in her hometown. 
Much like many prestigious schools, 
Funabashi Training Center was united as 
one.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm picking up the pace! Everyone, stay 
with me!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ohh!!

Furioso leads the pack. Right behind her, 
the other Umamusume give chase with 
fierce, burning eyes.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Full speed from here! YAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Pacing Group 1 can't move 
anymore! What should we do?
choice_data_list:
Switch to Group 2! Groups 3 and 4, start 
warming up!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yes!

For Furioso, for themselves, and for 
Funabashi, the Umamusume enter the track 
one after another.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Here are some refreshments! The local 
ladies made us rice balls and hearty miso 
soup packed with ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Woman
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing fancy, mind you. But in 
return, I packed it full of plenty of 
local veggies."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ladies... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Woman
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it, this is all for 
Funabashi's sake. Bring home the win, 
Furio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail—!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this sense of unity... And all 
these people cooperating so selflessly.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: With this unity, we can do it.
choice_data_list: Ah... I can do this, toe-to-toe!

Yeah... I can do this, we're evenly 
matched!

text_block_list.text: Time flies by. And amidst it all—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Please run tandem with me! I still 
haven't put in enough miles!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If I had to ask for more, I'd want to 
always run in three-person pairings 
instead of two!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! We've got plenty of 
numbers! Everyone at the Funabashi 
Training Center is our partner!"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Here's a little refreshment 
from us.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Man
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, sports drinks, and wet towels! We 
gathered these from all over Funabashi, so 
feel free to use whatever you need!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Tonight we have an 18-runner mock race. 
Anyone confident in their start dash, 
gather up.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Don't let Furioso-san take the lead! Let's 
test out every possible scenario.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Funabashi! Fight-oh! Fight-oh! Fight-oh!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

Aiming for the same victory together as 
one. That was a feeling you definitely 
wouldn't find in the Central.

"And a declaration of intent for the JBC 
Classic."

Furioso stands proudly before everyone. As 
the representative of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To all the Umamusume and staff members at 
Funabashi Tracen, thank you very much for 
your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, "cooperation"... isn't quite the right 
word. We simply share a single objective.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"There is something I wish to tell you 
before running the JBC Classic. And that 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It's "what we run for."

Furioso straightened her posture smoothly 
—and began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of the Central run for the 
sake of countless people.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Connecting with many people, bringing them 
joy and happiness. At times, that is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
She will spark a massive movement that 
will drive the entire nation wild.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That immense scale and sense of 
responsibility are the sources of the 
URA's strength. There is no doubt about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Everyone says it: "Know the vast ocean," 
"Connect with the many," "Bigness is 
power."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: However—is that truly the case?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think size is everything. Because 
I know better."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Cherishing the land where I grew up, 
cherishing my local friends, and living my 
life...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No matter how narrow it may be, I will 
live my life wishing for the prosperity of 
this land above all else.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Connecting with the masses isn't the only 
path. Forging deep bonds with a chosen few 
is another way. In other words..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Community solidarity. That is the true 
strength of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is something to be proud of, the only 
thing capable of standing up to the 
Central.

There are charms you'd never notice if you 
just stayed in your hometown. I only 
realized them because I went on this 
special study abroad program.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Running for the sake of something greater 
is what makes the URA wonderful. However—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi, who cherishes even the smallest 
things, is equally wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
And just because something is small 
doesn't mean it cannot defeat the large.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "We must— prove it."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's combine our strength! We have 
something that belongs to us and us alone!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us seize it—the future of our beloved 
Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Not defeat, but transcendence!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Oh!

The new path laid out before them. Not 
merely to defeat the Central, but to 
transcend it.

Funabashi vs. the JRA. The full weight of 
both sides' feelings clashes in the JBC 
Classic.
